recovery_audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-A - 15 Crash Recovery and State Reliability Scenarios

scenarios.name: Crash before event commit
scenarios.description: Engine halts before watermark advance; state remains initial cash $100k, 0 fills

scenarios.name: Crash after commit but before snapshot
scenarios.description: State is recoverable directly from replaying journal up to committed watermark

scenarios.name: Crash during snapshot creation
scenarios.description: Corrupted or incomplete snapshot fails cryptographic hash check

scenarios.name: Partial journal write detection
scenarios.description: Truncated trailing line detected and isolated without crashing parser

scenarios.name: Duplicate replay resilience
scenarios.description: Replaying journal events yields exact event count without duplicates

scenarios.name: Reversed event order resilience
scenarios.description: Late events arriving out of order are quarantined, preserving causal watermark

scenarios.name: Missing journal segment detection
scenarios.description: Gaps between last snapshot watermark and journal events are flagged

scenarios.name: Incorrect snapshot hash rejection
scenarios.description: Cryptographic hash mismatch raises fatal ValueError

scenarios.name: Recovery with pending order queue
scenarios.description: Pending orders are bounded to current session and evaluated cleanly

scenarios.name: Recovery after partial fill
scenarios.description: Average cost and cash reflect exact partially filled shares

scenarios.name: Recovery after order rejection
scenarios.description: Rejected orders do not mutate portfolio cash or holdings

scenarios.name: Recovery during corporate-action settlement (Split)
scenarios.description: Split ratio adjusts holdings and cost basis deterministically

scenarios.name: Recovery with dividend receivable
scenarios.description: Dividends credited to cash on payment date without phantom assets

scenarios.name: Restart after multi-day outage
scenarios.description: Resumed engine matches original state with 0 drift in cash or equity
